correctness.rationale: For any non-exceptional irreducible curve different from the two marked lines, Bézout against those lines forces -K.C>=degree; adjunction forces nonnegative square in degree >=2. All remaining negative curves are explicitly listed. Cross-line supports form a bipartite star, and the exact Schur-complement test for the distinguished pair gives precisely the excluded integer cardinality case. Every generating-function term is uniquely indexed. Exact integer exhaustive checks inspect all 131072 and 2097152 subsets for parameters (3,3) and (3,4), respectively; they corroborate but do not replace the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The theorem is the full two-parameter, three-variable chamber profile for a natural two-line blow-up family of unbounded Picard number. General source algorithms do not imply explicit formulas without a new negative-curve and star/Schur-complement classification. A previously known six-point (3,3) numerical profile is strictly contained in the result, while (3,4) and (4,4) lie outside it. No exact broad profile was found in the actual targeted published-record and primary-literature checks; priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: Two collinear blocks on distinct lines are a geometrically canonical special-position family of plane blowups; the full three-variable support enumerator determines all big-cone Zariski chambers and whether the two negative line transforms enter their negative parts for every n,m >=3. The two-block Schur determinant creates genuine coupling absent in one-line or smooth-conic families; the unbounded-Picard classification includes an exact total formula and nontrivial maximal-support counts beyond the previously covered six-point case.
